summary.name: AI Video Creator
summary.one_liner: A downloadable PC and Mac video-creation software sold as a one-time $27 purchase, bundling 1,500 template slides, 500 pre-written script lines, and pre-recorded voice-overs.
use_cases: Creating marketing videos for YouTube and Facebook
Making affiliate product review or explainer videos
Producing promo videos for eCommerce or local businesses
Building simple template-based slideshow videos with voice-overs
Generating videos for clients under a commercial license
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes a Windows and Mac software package with 1,500 template slides across 15 niche packs plus a generic pack, and 500 pre-written script lines each with recorded UK voice-over options. Users choose a backing track, background image and font, pick niche templates and script lines, then edit text, add images or video, and apply one of 23 motion graphic animations per slide. The page says videos can be exported and uploaded to YouTube, Facebook, Vimeo or a website, with unlimited renders. The page also lists 9 backing tracks, 11 background images and 12 fonts.</what_it_does>
